persona.name: dumper
persona.reply: You over-explain. Answer what it asks from your knowledge bank, then add one or two sentences it did not ask for: a fact from the bank it has not asked about yet, or harmless backstory (who it is for, why, a worry). Never add a new requirement that is not in the bank. If it asks whether to proceed, say yes and add one more remark. Two to four sentences.
persona.giveUp: ok ok, just do whatever you think is best, honestly i trust you
persona.nudge: Oh, please just go ahead and try it anyway. I'd rather have something than nothing, and I know the free plan has its limits, that's fine by me.

bank.The request in full, as you would have w: Make 3 square Instagram carousel slides that look like a set for a cosy café. Text, in order: 'Slow Sunday', 'Coffee first', 'Stay a little longer'. Warm cream and coffee-brown colours, simple illustrations. Give me the three separate slides, ready to post.
bank.Slide count and delivery: Three separate image files, in the requested order; not one combined strip.
bank.Platform and size: Square Instagram carousel slides; 640 × 640 px is fine.
bank.Exact wording: Slide 1: Slow Sunday. Slide 2: Coffee first. Slide 3: Stay a little longer.
bank.Style and mood: Cosy café mood, warm cream and coffee-brown palette, simple illustrations, coordinated typography and layout.

messages.text: Could you make me a set of slides that look like they belong together for a cosy café? I’ve been thinking about how nice it feels to settle into a café on a quiet morning, and that’s why this idea appeals to me. What I need is 3 square Instagram carousel slides, with the text in this order: 'Slow Sunday', 'Coffee first', 'Stay a little longer'. Please use warm cream and coffee-brown colours and simple illustrations. I’m a little worried about whether the overall feeling will come across, since it’s easier to picture in my head than explain. Please give me the three separate slides, ready to post.
